title: 第3章 超级记忆
content_zh:
“哼，势利的东西！”冲着那肥胖护士的背影，季枫冷冷的骂了一句。

“枫儿，你真的长大了！”看着儿子那已经比自己高上半个头的身躯，以及那还带着一丝稚嫩的脸庞，肖素梅不禁欣慰的笑了。

刚才与那肥胖的护士发生冲突，肖素梅生怕季枫会克制不住自己的脾气，动手打那个护士，那样的话，后果可就严重了。

但是结果却让肖素梅欣慰不已，季枫从容的将那肥胖护士引入了他早就准备好的圈套，让她自取其辱，这比动手打人都要狠辣。

“妈，我说过的，以后不会再让你受到一点委屈，更不会让人再看不起你！”季枫坚定的说道。

“妈相信你！”肖素梅欣慰的点点头。

季枫忽然想起了刚才那肥胖护士的话，忙问道：“妈，我是不是昏迷了三天？”

一提起这个，肖素梅顿时紧张了起来，慌忙点头，问道：“枫儿，你现在感觉身体怎么？有没有哪里不舒服？”

季枫的心中流过一阵暖流，看着刚四十岁的母亲，脸上已经有了沧桑之色，他的心中就忍不住一阵绞痛，为了把自己养大，母亲到底吃了多少苦？！

“妈，你放心吧，我没事。你看！”季枫挥了挥拳头，顿时觉得虎虎生风，仿佛浑身充满了力量，他忍不住一阵惊奇，却也高兴不已。

以往的时候，因为营养跟不上，所以季枫的身体有些孱弱，这种充满力量的感觉可是从来没有过的！

“一定是在医院躺了这几天，休息的好，才有了力气！”季枫如此猜测。

看着儿子不似假装，肖素梅这才放心下来。

季枫说道：“妈，我们走吧，我已经完全好了。”

“走吧！”肖素梅轻叹一声，若不是手头拮据，她又怎么舍得在儿子刚醒来就离开医院？

两人刚一走出病房，就见那个肥胖的护士正站在走廊中，一脸鄙夷的看着他们。

见到两人离开，那护士不屑的嘀咕道：“哼！穷鬼，没钱还好意思住院！”

季枫的脸色顿时阴沉了下来，冷哼一声：“哼！”

肖素梅拍了拍儿子的后背，低声说道：“枫儿，算了！”

季枫深深的吸了口气，微微点头，说道：“妈，我们走！”

走出医院，季枫忍不住使劲的呼吸了几口外面的新鲜空气，医院里的药水味实在是太刺鼻，让他很不舒服。

“枫儿，把东西放在车上吧！”肖素梅从不远处的停车棚下，将家里唯一的脚踏三轮车骑了过来。

季枫顿时愧疚的问道：“妈，这几天为了照顾我，耽误的你都没有去卖菜吧？”

“傻孩子！”来到跟前，肖素梅笑着拍了一下季枫的脑袋，“妈卖菜还不都是为了你啊，如果你出了什么事，妈就算赚再多的钱又有什么用！”

季枫摸着被拍的脑袋嘿嘿一笑，他能感受到母亲对他的宠爱。

“对了，妈，现在时间还早，我不回家了，先去学校吧！”季枫突然想起了什么，说道：“刚开学我就旷了三天的课，还是早点补上！”

肖素梅劝道：“枫儿，学校里我已经帮你请过假了，还是先回家休息一天吧，明天再去学校也不迟啊！”

季枫摇了摇头，道：“妈，我现在已经高三了，学习要抓紧了，我一定会争气的！”

见儿子这样坚持，肖素梅也就不再劝说了，而是高兴的点头，道：“那好，妈下午去买点肉，等你晚上放学回家，给你好好补补！”

季枫笑着点头，然后与母亲分开，去了学校。

看着儿子的背影，肖素梅脸上的笑容逐渐变成了忧愁的神色，低声呢喃：“儿子就要靠大学了，可是这学费……”

她咬了咬牙，低声自语道：“不管用什么办法，哪怕是砸锅卖铁，也要让枫儿上大学！”

再次踏进邙石县二中的校门，季枫仿佛有一种重获新生的感觉。三天前，就在二中的操场上，胡雪慧说出了那番绝情的话语。

“一切都已经过去了！”季枫坚定的对自己说，“季枫，你不是一个人，为了你那含辛茹苦的母亲，你也要奋发。你看让别人看不起，但是，你却不能让母亲也跟你一样受人白眼！”

整理了一下衣服，季枫脸色平静的朝着教室走去。

季枫所在的班级，是邙石二中高三年级六班，在教学楼的第二层。

此时大约是上午十点左右，学校里很安静，应该都在上课。

来到了教室门口，季枫对着正在讲课的老师说道：“报告，我迟到了！”

老师是一个五十多岁的中年男人，戴着一副眼睛，显得很和蔼，他点了点头，道：“进来吧！”

季枫刚一进教室，全班所有学生的目光就都集中在了他的身上，有幸灾乐祸的神色，有鄙夷的不屑，也有同情的目光。

季枫从容自然的走到了自己的座位上，坐了下来，在他的右边原本是胡雪慧的位置，现在坐着一个男生。

这个男生名叫张磊，从高一开始就与季枫是同班同学，也是季枫唯一的朋友。只不过，季枫无论怎么努力，成绩也只是平平，好不突出。但是张磊就不同了，这小子除了上课意外，似乎从来不看书，但是每次考试，都是稳定在年级前十名，班内更是稳稳的前三。

与被公认为二中校花的六班班长童蕾，以及副班长徐默，三人被人称为六班的三把尖刀，可见张磊的成绩之好！

只不过，从外表上看去，没有人会认为张磊是个好学生。一头黄毛，上衣敞开，一副流里流气的样子，这就是张磊的标志性打扮。

季枫刚一坐下来，张磊就歪过了身子，低声道：“疯子，你没事吧？”

季枫摇了摇头，低声笑道：“没事，只是中暑了！”

张磊撇了撇嘴，显然是不信，说道：“你和胡雪慧的事情我听说了，那样的势利的女人，不要也罢，不要多想了，等放学了哥们带你去海鲜酒楼搓一顿，够意思吧？”

季枫不禁一笑，心中一股暖意在流淌。他知道，全班四十多个学生，能够真心安慰自己的，也就只有张磊这一个朋友了！

“下面，继续上课！”讲台上老师继续讲课，季枫从书桌里拿出书本，准备将落下的功课补上。

刚开学三天，学习的课程并不是很多，季枫看起来也就很轻松，所以到下课的时候，所有落下的内容他就已经看完了。

下课铃声响起，季枫也正好看完了所有的课程。

“我说疯子，你没事吧？”旁边的张磊凑了过来，眼睛眯眯笑着，“我们上的是物理课，你拿英语看什么？”

季枫瞪了他一眼，合上书本，哼道：“你以为谁都跟你一样，学了就会吗？我落下了三天的课程，再不补上的话，怎么考大学？还有，不要再叫我疯子！”

张磊嘿嘿一笑，也不在乎：“你本来就是疯子嘛！”

两人说笑间，季枫不由的轻松了下来，他知道，张磊这是在变相的安慰自己，他的心头不由一热。也只有在朋友面前，他才能够真正的轻松下来。

摇头笑笑，季枫准备拿出之前看过的课本，其中有两个问题他无法理解，想要请教一下张磊。

季枫发现，当他的脑子里回想着那两个问题的时候，之前看过的书，就好像放电影一样，在他的脑海中清晰的闪现。

“这是……过目不忘？！”季枫呆呆的想。
content_en:
"Hmph, you snobbish thing!" Ji Feng cursed coldly at the back of the fat nurse.

"Feng'er, you've really grown up!" Looking at her son's body, which was already half a head taller than her, and his face that still had a hint of childishness, Xiao Sumei couldn't help but smile with relief.

After the conflict with the fat nurse just now, Xiao Sumei was afraid that Ji Feng would not be able to control his temper and hit the nurse. In that case, the consequences would be serious.

But the result made Xiao Sumei very happy. Ji Feng calmly led the obese nurse into the trap he had prepared long ago and let her humiliate herself. This was more cruel than beating someone.

"Mom, I said, I will never let you suffer any injustice in the future, let alone let people look down on you again!" Ji Feng said firmly.

"Mom, I believe you!" Xiao Sumei nodded happily.

Ji Feng suddenly remembered what the fat nurse said just now, and asked quickly: "Mom, was I comatose for three days?"

When this was mentioned, Xiao Sumei suddenly became nervous, nodded hurriedly, and asked: "Feng'er, how do you feel now? Do you feel uncomfortable anywhere?"

A warm current flowed through Ji Feng's heart. Looking at his mother, who was just forty years old, with a look of vicissitudes of life on her face, he couldn't help but feel a twinge of pain in his heart. How much hardship did his mother suffer in order to raise him?!

"Mom, don't worry, I'm fine. Look!" Ji Feng waved his fist and suddenly felt like he was full of strength. He couldn't help but be surprised, but also very happy.

In the past, Ji Feng's body was a little weak due to insufficient nutrition. He had never felt this powerful before!

"I must have been lying in the hospital for the past few days and had a good rest, so I gained strength!" Ji Feng guessed.

Seeing that her son didn't seem to be pretending, Xiao Sumei felt relieved.

Ji Feng said: "Mom, let's go, I'm completely recovered."

"Let's go!" Xiao Sumei sighed softly. If she hadn't been short of money, how could she be willing to leave the hospital just after her son woke up?

As soon as the two of them walked out of the ward, they saw the fat nurse standing in the corridor, looking at them with contempt.

Seeing the two people leaving, the nurse muttered disdainfully: "Huh! Poor guy, you have the nerve to be hospitalized if you don't have money!"

Ji Feng's face suddenly darkened, and he snorted coldly: "Huh!"

Xiao Sumei patted her son's back and whispered: "Feng'er, forget it!"

Ji Feng took a deep breath, nodded slightly, and said, "Mom, let's go!"

After walking out of the hospital, Ji Feng couldn't help but take a few breaths of fresh air outside. The smell of the medicine in the hospital was so pungent that it made him very uncomfortable.

"Feng'er, put your things in the car!" Xiao Sumei rode the only tricycle in the family from the parking shed not far away.

Ji Feng suddenly asked guiltily: "Mom, in order to take care of me these days, you haven't even gone to sell vegetables, right?"

"Silly boy!" Xiao Sumei came forward and patted Ji Feng's head with a smile, "Mom sells vegetables all because of you. If something happens to you, it will be of no use no matter how much money mom makes!"

Ji Feng touched the patted head and smiled. He could feel his mother's love for him.

"By the way, Mom, it's still early. I won't go home. Let's go to school first!" Ji Feng suddenly remembered something and said, "I missed three days of classes just after school started, so I'd better make up for it early!"

Xiao Sumei advised: "Feng'er, I've already asked for leave from school for you. It's better to go home and rest for a day. It's not too late to go to school tomorrow!"

Ji Feng shook his head and said, "Mom, I'm in my senior year of high school now. I have to study hard. I will definitely do my best!"

Seeing her son's insistence, Xiao Sumei stopped persuading her and nodded happily, saying, "Okay, mom will buy some meat in the afternoon, and when you come home from school in the evening, I'll give you a good supplement!"

Ji Feng smiled and nodded, then separated from his mother and went to school.

Looking at her son's back, the smile on Xiao Sumei's face gradually turned into a sad look, and she murmured in a low voice: "My son is going to college, but the tuition fee..."

She gritted her teeth and whispered to herself: "No matter what method is used, even if it is to sell the iron, we must let Feng'er go to college!"

Stepping into the gate of Manshi County No. 2 Middle School again, Ji Feng seemed to feel like he had been reborn.Three days ago, on the playground of No. 2 Middle School, Hu Xuehui said those heartless words.

"Everything is over!" Ji Feng said to himself firmly, "Ji Feng, you are not alone. You must work hard for your mother who has endured so much hardship. You may look down upon others, but you cannot let your mother be looked down upon by others like you!"

After tidying up his clothes, Ji Feng walked towards the classroom with a calm expression.

Ji Feng's class is Class 6, Grade 3, Manshi No. 2 Middle School, on the second floor of the teaching building.

It was about ten o'clock in the morning. The school was very quiet. Everyone should be in class.

Arriving at the door of the classroom, Ji Feng said to the teacher who was giving a lecture: "Report, I'm late!"

The teacher was a middle-aged man in his fifties. He wore a pair of glasses and looked very kind. He nodded and said, "Come in!"

As soon as Ji Feng entered the classroom, the eyes of all the students in the class were focused on him, with expressions of gloating, disdain, and sympathy.

Ji Feng walked to his seat calmly and naturally, and sat down. On his right, where Hu Xuehui was originally, a boy now sat.

This boy's name is Zhang Lei. He has been in the same class with Ji Feng since the first year of high school and is Ji Feng's only friend.However, no matter how hard Ji Feng worked, his results were mediocre, not outstanding.But Zhang Lei is different. Except for accidents in class, this kid never seems to read. However, every time he takes an exam, he is always in the top ten in his grade, and he is firmly in the top three in the class.

Together with Tong Lei, the squad leader of Class 6, who is recognized as the beauty of the second middle school, and Xu Mo, the deputy squad leader, the three of them are called the three sharp knives of Class 6, which shows Zhang Lei's excellent results!

However, from the outside, no one would think that Zhang Lei is a good student.With yellow hair, an open shirt, and a slutty look, this is Zhang Lei's iconic look.

As soon as Ji Feng sat down, Zhang Lei turned over and whispered: "Madman, are you okay?"

Ji Feng shook his head and laughed softly: "It's okay, I just have heat stroke!"

Zhang Lei curled his lips, obviously not believing it, and said: "I heard about you and Hu Xuehui. It's okay not to want such a snobbish woman. Don't think too much about it. When school is over, my buddy will take you to a seafood restaurant for a meal. Isn't that fun?"

Ji Feng couldn't help but smile, a warmth flowing in his heart.He knew that among the more than 40 students in the class, the only friend who could truly comfort him was Zhang Lei!

"Next, let's continue the class!" The teacher on the podium continued to teach. Ji Feng took out the book from the desk and prepared to make up for the missed homework.

It had just been three days since school started, and there were not many courses to learn. Ji Feng seemed to be very relaxed, so by the time get out of class was over, he had already read all the content he had missed.

The bell rang for the end of get out of class, and Ji Feng just finished reading all the courses.

"I said crazy, are you okay?" Zhang Lei, who was standing next to him, came over and smiled with his eyes narrowed, "We are taking a physics class, what are you reading in English?"

Ji Feng glared at him, closed the book, and hummed: "Do you think everyone is like you and can learn well? I missed three days of classes. If I don't make up for it, how will I get into college? And don't call me crazy again!"

Zhang Lei chuckled and didn't care: "You are a madman to begin with!"

While the two were chatting and laughing, Ji Feng couldn't help but feel relaxed. He knew that Zhang Lei was trying to comfort him in disguise, and his heart couldn't help but feel warm.Only in front of friends can he truly relax.

Shaking his head and smiling, Ji Feng was about to take out the textbook he had read before. There were two questions in it that he couldn't understand and wanted to ask Zhang Lei for advice.

Ji Feng found that when he was thinking about those two questions in his mind, the books he had read before flashed clearly in his mind like a movie.

"Is this... photographic memory?!" Ji Feng thought blankly.
